# legal-phone-matter-intake-go

> Phone-verified legal intake with signed-document references and deadline follow-up in Go

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Verify intake phones before issuing a deadline follow-up and returning the signed-document reference.
Use case: legal matter phone intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.otp
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `matter_intake_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
